Name: ConversationSystem (Skill)
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[/center][center][quote]This is a brand-new conversation skill, featuring 6 unique professions.
The mod includes a large amount of dynamic dialogue, allowing you to discuss other villagers with them.
You can use conversation skills to trade with villagers, offering a new way to benefit your farm.
You might also help with simple tasks or earn friendship by complimenting villagers.
And your spouse will start becoming much more helpful... see for yourself!

With this mod,
besides farming, fishing, chopping trees, and mining,
you’ll gain a new gameplay experience—interacting with villagers throughout the town.
But conversations aren’t just about gaining friendship; they’re also fun and rewarding.
Through chatting, you’ll receive items from villagers and even sell your unwanted goods to them.[/quote][/center][center]
﻿[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img][/center][center][b][size=6]﻿Features
[/size][/b][quote][size=4]Entertaining dialogue[/size]

[size=4]new conversation skill with unique professions[/size]
[size=2][spoiler]
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Level 5 - Salesperson : Guarantees a trade option when holding an item during conversation.[/b]
[b]Level 10 - Negotiation Expert : Reduces friendship loss by 50% when negotiations fail.[/b]
[b]Level 10 - Boutique : Increases the selling price of items during conversation by 20%.[/b]

[b]Level 5 - Close Friend : Increases friendship gained from praise by 50%.[/b]
[b]Level 10 - Charmer : Grants a chance to receive a gift upon successful praise.[/b]
[b]Level 10 - Chat Expert: Increases daily conversation limit with villagers by +1.[/b]
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/spoiler][/size]
[size=4]Trade with villagers (haggle to buy low and sell high)[/size]

[size=4]Spend stamina to compliment villagers (may fail)[/size]

[size=4]Small personal requests directly from villagers[/size]

[size=4]Talk to villagers about others in town[/size]

[size=4]Villagers will show concern about your recent actions[/size]

[size=4]Spouse/roommate offers more help[/size]

[size=4]Other small surprises…[/size][/quote]
﻿[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[size=6][b]Showcase Video[/b][/size]
[youtube]m8HJZ_nGXX0[/youtube]

[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[b]﻿[size=6]﻿How to use[/size][/b][/center][center][quote][size=5][b]Just one button: [color=#ff0000]Q[/color][/b][/size] (default)

[b]Use conversation skill[/b][b]: [/b]
[i]Approach a villager and press [/i][i]Q
[b]Gamepad:[/b] Quickly press L and R[/i]

[b]Open conversation menu[/b][b]: [/b]
[i]Double-tap [/i][i]Q when not near any villager
[b]Gamepad:[/b] Quickly press R and L[/i][/quote]
[b][img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[/b][b][size=6]How to Trade with Villagers[/size][/b]
[b][/b][quote][b][size=4]Selling Items[/size][/b]
Use the conversation skill on a villager while holding the item you want to sell.
Early selling options appear randomly, but will always appear if you have the corresponding profession.

[b][size=4]Buying Items[/size][/b]
You can actively ask villagers about the items they carry.
Alternatively, if a villager mentions any item during conversation, it may trigger a trade opportunity.
For example, if Emily mentions that Haley likes sunflowers, she might offer to sell you sunflowers.[/quote]
[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[size=6][b]Conversation Menu Options[/b][/size]
[quote][size=4][b]Review social advice...[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Tips and reminders for using the conversation system.
Also displays your current conversation skill XP percentage above the farmer’s head.[/i]
[/size]
[size=4][b]View villagers’ requests...[/b][/size]
[i][size=3]Only appears if you’ve accepted any villager requests.
Shows all currently accepted requests from villagers.[/size][/i]

[size=4][b]View villagers’ debts...[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Only appears if you’ve lent money to any villagers.
Displays the amount each villager owes you.[/i][/size]

[b][size=4]View who’s having a birthday today...[/size][/b]
[i][size=3]Only appears if there’s a birthday today.
Shows today’s birthday villager and their current location.
[/size][/i]
[b][size=4]Reset Conversation Profession.[/size][/b]
[i][size=3]Only appears if enabled in GMCM and your conversation level is above 5.
Resets your chosen profession, allowing you to experience the effects of a different one.[/size][/i][/quote][size=4][/size]
[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[size=6][b]﻿Compatibility[/b][/size][/center][center][quote]Uses a dedicated key to activate conversation without overriding any original dialogues

Supports all NPCs with friendship

Adding this mod to existing save files causes no issues

Removing this mod from existing save files causes no issues

If other mods have shortcut key conflicts with [b]Q[/b], you can change the key in GMCM

Gifts from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17714]Reciprocate[/url]﻿ can no longer be sold back to villagers (more reasonable).

Supports popular expansion mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]ES[/url]﻿.

Since I don't have the extra energy to maintain proper Mobile support, :(
please consider the mod unsupported on that platform if you encounter any issues.[/quote][/center][center]
[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[size=6][b]Localization Support[/b][/size][/center][center][quote]Currently supports English and Chinese.
Since English is not my native language, the current English version was translated using Grok.
If you notice any issues or have better translation suggestions, feel free to contact me on the site.

If you're a translator for another language,
you're welcome to localize the i18n files yourself and upload them to Nexus Mods.
However, you may only upload the completed i18n translation files, and be sure to list this mod under [b]Requirements[/b].[/quote]﻿
[img]https://images.plurk.com/7dxPNazBqGKrWyIibOPO53.png[/img]
[size=6][b]If you enjoy this mod[/b][/size][/center][quote][center][size=4]If you’d like to support my work,
you're warmly welcome to do so on [url=https://ko-fi.com/yunhikari]Kofi[/url]
your kindness will be a great encouragement for me to keep creating.[/size][/center][/quote]
